header.title: How to Replace a Dryer Moisture Sensor
header.description: This guide provides step-by-step instructions on how to safely replace a faulty moisture sensor in your dryer. Follow these instructions to diagnose and resolve dryer issues related to improper drying.

steps.description: The first step is to unplug the dryer and create enough workspace behind it.
actions: Unplug the dryer
Pull the dryer away from the wall

steps.description: Remove the top panel of the dryer by removing two nuts and sliding the panel off.
actions: Locate the two nuts securing the top panel to the rear panel on the back of the dryer.
Remove the two nuts using a nut driver.
Slide the top panel off the dryer.
Set the top panel aside.

steps.description: This step involves disconnecting the control console from the dryer by removing screws and a wiring harness.
actions: Undo the screws with your screwdriver.
Unplug the wiring harness.
Unscrew the four screws connecting the control console to the dryer.
Gently lift the console.
Place the console onto the drum.
Place all screws in a safe place.

steps.description: This step involves removing the front panel of the dryer by unscrewing six screws and then lifting the panel away.
actions: Locate the 6 screws holding the front panel.
Unscrew the four screws on the top of the dryer.
Open the dryer door.
Unscrew the two screws inside the dryer at the bottom of the door lip.
Place all screws with the other screws.
Gently lift the front panel up.
Remove the front panel from the dryer.
Place the front panel out of the way with the top panel.

steps.description: This step details how to remove the dryer moisture sensor by disconnecting the wiring harness and unscrewing it from the dryer.
actions: Locate the dryer moisture sensor on the front bulkhead.
Unplug the wire harness.
Undo the single screw.
Place the screw with the others.
Pull the dryer moisture sensor out of the dryer.
Set the dryer moisture sensor aside.

steps.description: Attach the new dryer moisture sensor to the drum and reconnect the wiring.
actions: Screw the new dryer moisture sensor onto the drum
Reattach the wiring harness

steps.description: Reattach the front panel of the dryer by securing screws in the door lip and on top.
actions: Slide the front panel back into place.
Screw back in the two screws in the door lip.
Reattach the four screws on top.

steps.description: Reinstall the control console by securing it with screws, plugging in the wiring harness, and tightening the final screws.
actions: Move the control console back into place
Return the four screws attaching the console to the dryer
Plug the wiring harness back in
Screw in the final two screws

steps.description: Slide the top panel back into place and secure it with nuts.
actions: slide top panel into place
secure top panel with nuts

steps.description: Slide the dryer back into its original position and ensure it is plugged in.
actions: Slide the dryer back against the wall
Plug it in
